1.explanation: This minimal React example uses @alifd/next’s Table with the `sortable` prop on two columns. When you run it and hover over the up/down arrow icons in the header, you will see that the cursor does not change to a pointer, reproducing the issue reported. You can open the browser DevTools and inspect the sort icon element to confirm that no `cursor: pointer` style is applied.
1.bug_scenario: In the official Table “Sorting and filtering” demo, when you hover over the sort icons in a sortable column header (for example the “Id” column), the mouse cursor remains the default arrow instead of turning into a pointer. This makes it hard to tell that the icons are clickable to trigger sorting.
